work.description: The act treats the canonization of the Japanese martyrs. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX. — PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF131-135) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF16708-16711 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SHMIPUBLICO DIE XXII MAIL ANNO MDCCCLAII. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
